{"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"Berkeley","level":"city","category":"rent_increase_limits","status":"in_force","title":"Berkeley Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for 2026","requirement":"Eligible landlords may increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by the Annual General Adjustment of 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set by formula at 65% of the increase in the CPI for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area (July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025 CPI increase was 1.5%). The 65% of CPI formula was approved by Berkeley voters in November 2004. Regulation 1148 sets the conditions for qualifying for the increase and the notice that must be given to tenants. The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents of tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.","key_value":"2026 AGA 1.0% (65% of 1.5% CPI increase), effective no earlier than 2026-01-01","coverage_conditions":"Rent-stabilized units under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance whose landlords are eligible for the adjustment; the document does not give building-level coverage cut-offs.","exemptions":"2026 AGA does not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.","coverage_logic":{"covers":null,"exempt":null},"subject":"landlord","interaction":null,"yields_to_local":false,"preempts_local":false,"effective_date":"2026-01-01","effective_rule":null,"enacted_date":"2025-10-16","end_date":null,"penalty":null,"citation":"Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110(A); Berkeley Rent Board Regulation 1148","quoted_span":"The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after 
January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental 
Housing Act.","supporting_spans":["The 65% of CPI formula was approved by Berkeley voters in the November 2004 general 
municipal election."],"confidence":0.8,"conflict_note":null}],"notes":"Only the Berkeley rent stabilization AGA notice is in scope. Costa-Hawkins is mentioned only as the basis for the exclusion and is not described in enough detail to record as a separate rule. The notice is dated October 17, 2025 and the Board adopted the order October 16, 2025; the status is in_force as of 2026-10-01 since the adjustment applies from 2026-01-01. Quoted spans preserve the document's line breaks."}
